---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability for Burhan
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A description of the problem, e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]".

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What should Burhan do differently? For a new detector, name the vulnerability
class and — if possible — a public reference (OWASP category, CWE, spec).

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you considered.

**Scope check**
- [ ] This does not change existing scan behavior when no flag is set
      (house rule: new capabilities are feature-flagged, default OFF).
- [ ] Any new cryptographic primitive would be library-backed with
      official test vectors (house rule: no hand-rolled crypto).

**Additional context**
Anything else — links, examples, prior art.
